text: Pogačar arrives at Orcières-Merlette—one of the Tour's most feared finales—with the mountains jersey already secured, which means UAE can dial back aggression and let rivals burn themselves on the two Cat 1s before the summit. Evenepoel's unconventional third-week strategy gets its acid test here: four minutes back with two Alpine stages remaining, he'll need to either explode on the climb or accept that Pogačar's control game may be too suffocating to break. Watch for Ayuso and Seixas, still within striking distance but running out of stages to make time—they can't afford to follow wheels today if they want the podium.
